high_impact_preferences:
T11-P1 Niche: AI applications + industry trends + entrepreneurship > generic technology-news aggregation.
T11-P2 Audience: professional builders/founders/serious AI practitioners > mass entertainment audience.
T11-P3 Voice: practitioner/expert credibility > lifestyle-personality influencer identity.
T11-P4 Content evidence: real projects/cases/technical-business insight > generic commentary.
T11-P5 Resource model: lean, high-efficiency, ROI-conscious creation > large production team/budget by default.
average_impact_preferences:
T11-A1 Platform mix: include professional/knowledge-oriented channels > entertainment channels only.
T11-A2 Production schedule: weekday-focused creation > weekend-heavy production schedule.
T11-A3 Content tone: analytical/logical explanation > purely emotional/hype-driven presentation.
acceptable_clarification_paraphrases:
T11-P1
- Which niche feels most natural: AI applications/industry/entrepreneurship or general tech news?
- Do you want to focus on real AI use cases and startup/industry insight?
- What topics do you most want the account to become known for?

T11-P2
- Who do you most want to attract: professional builders/founders/AI practitioners or a broad entertainment audience?
- Is professional audience quality more important than mass reach?
- Which audience would be most valuable for your long-term goals?

T11-P3
- Should the account feel like an expert/practitioner brand or more like a lifestyle/personality account?
- How much should your professional expertise define the voice?
- Do you want credibility to come mainly from real experience and analysis?

T11-P4
- Do you want to publish mostly real project/case-based insight or general commentary?
- How important is grounding content in first-hand technical/business experience?
- Should real examples and lessons from your work be central?

T11-P5
- Are you willing to build a larger content team, or do you prefer a lean solo/low-overhead setup?
- How important is ROI and efficiency in content production?
- Should tools/outsourcing only be added when they clearly justify their cost?
